people_details: Synthetic example: two adults and one child. Everyone can walk independently.
situation_details: We need food and drinking water. Everyone is safe upstairs. The access road is dry, and water is not rising near the building. No urgent medical needs reported.

people_details: Synthetic example: two adults and one older adult who cannot walk without assistance. The older adult's regular medication has run out; the name is unknown.
situation_details: Water is chest deep on the access path and rising into our last refuge. There is no higher refuge. The road is cut off by water. We need urgent rescue.

people_details: Synthetic example: two adults. One adult is unresponsive. We do not know their medical history.
situation_details: We need urgent medical help and evacuation. We have not checked the water depth or the access road.

people_details: Synthetic example: one adult and one older adult who uses a wheelchair. Please prepare assistance for moving the wheelchair user.
situation_details: We are safe on a dry second floor for now, but need assisted evacuation. Knee-deep water blocks the access road. Water has stayed at the same level for the last two hours. No injury or immediate danger reported.

people_details: Synthetic example: three adults and one infant. We need infant supplies along with food and drinking water.
situation_details: Everyone is safe on the upper floor. There is fast-moving water outside and debris across the access road. We cannot estimate its depth. We do not know whether a vehicle or boat can reach us.
